name: TR-Obsidian Copilot
description: MCP-first Obsidian Copilot fork, part of the TR-Obsidian Intelligence Network Citations suite. Adds a Model Context Protocol client so Copilot chat can call tools exposed by the TrevClaw obsidian-copilot-bridge and the OpenClaw Command Center over their Unix sockets in ~/.local/state/trinc/run (vault-bridge.sock, command-center.sock), plus a headless custom-command runner that writes results straight to a note.
